title: Severity Credit on Returnless Damage Credits - Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders
content:
For a Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders returnless damage credit, the severity credit compares the damaged units - the units on the damage report being settled, that is the latest declined damage request on the order by requested date - with the units charged on the order's line charges.

| Damaged units as a share of the units charged | Severity credit |
|---|---|
| Half (0.5) or more | $2.00 |
| A quarter (0.25) or more, but less than half | $1.00 |
| Less than a quarter | Nothing |

### Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical order of 8 units)

| Damaged units | Share | Severity credit |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0.125 | Nothing |
| 2 | 0.25 | $1.00 |
| 3 | 0.375 | $1.00 |
| 4 | 0.5 | $2.00 |

The share is the damaged units divided by all units charged on the order, across every line charge, and is compared unrounded.
